About Brightpath Analytics

Brightpath Analytics is a demand-forecasting platform that cuts stockouts for mid-market retailers running 5 to 50 warehouses. The company was founded in Portland, Oregon on 11 March 2019 by Dana Okonkwo and Ravi Sethuraman, both former supply-chain engineers.

Talk to the team

Founding facts

Brightpath was incorporated on 11 March 2019 in Portland, Oregon. The company employs 31 people across offices in Portland and Manchester, and has been profitable since Q2 2024.

The team

Dana Okonkwo is chief executive and spent nine years planning replenishment for a national grocery chain. Ravi Sethuraman is chief technology officer and previously built routing systems for a freight carrier. The wider team is 14 engineers, 9 in customer operations, and 8 in commercial roles.

Where to find us

The Portland office is at 418 Harbour Street, Portland, OR 97204, United States. Reception is open 09:00 to 17:00 Pacific time on weekdays and the number is +1-555-0142.

Press and media

Journalists can download the logo pack and the approved company boilerplate from the press page. Dana Okonkwo is the named spokesperson.
